coverage_broad.explantion: Both responses suffer from Narrow Focus/Tunnel Vision and Missing Major Aspect, which are the most serious failures for broad coverage. consistency_internal.explantion: Both response a and response b suffer from the same high‑severity internal‑consistency flaws: each blurs distinct initiatives (CBS diversity targets, Endeavor Content guidelines, Comcast RISE grants) into a single narrative, presents debatable assessments as settled facts (false consensus), and fails to explicitly attribute statements to their sources.
